models.name: Muse Ember
models.notes: League 1; calibration definition pending Ümit; late entry: its own decisions in late-entry matches against League 1's field (different positions from the league's); scored against League 1's Random; played 17 of 19 matches; GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API): outside the requested scope (Ümit, 12 Nov); not played (opponent's API out of credit); Inception Mercury Decide: outside the requested scope (Ümit, 12 Nov); not played (opponent no longer served on OpenRouter); Meta's Muse Ember through OpenRouter, pinned to Meta (fallbacks off) for every decision; never on our GPUs. Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 10–11 Nov 2026. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #932 stopped before any decision, unbilled; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov). Every request sent reasoning_effort "max"; 21.76 M of its 22.09 M output tokens were reasoning. The endpoint returned no token probabilities, so it answers with one letter, read from the reply; 46 of its 1,713 answers named no option and a random legal play was made. A quality check (12 Nov) found that 1 of those 46 was an OpenRouter provider error (no answer) scored as invalid, in match #926; the other 45 were real length cuts. A full Run 2 of match #926 (same seed, fixed runner 175141f, its own database) played 6 games to 0 against Random with 0 provider errors; the published numbers keep the original match. Each decision is billed at Meta's list price from the tokens OpenRouter reported.; hosted (API or subscription)

models.name: Gemini Decision 1
models.notes: League 1; calibration definition pending Ümit; late entry: its own decisions in late-entry matches against League 1's field (different positions from the league's); scored against League 1's Random; played 17 of 19 matches; GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API): outside the requested scope (Ümit, 12 Nov); not played (opponent's API out of credit); Inception Mercury Decide: outside the requested scope (Ümit, 12 Nov); not played (opponent no longer served on OpenRouter); Google's Gemini Decision 1 through OpenRouter, pinned to Google AI Studio (fallbacks off) for every decision; never on our GPUs. Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 11 Nov 2026. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #1016 aborted; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov). Two runner builds: dab6da5 for its first 9 matches (#993–#1013, before 21:46:31 UTC), with no probability-map check, and 38024d6 (map-check v2) from 21:46:31 UTC for its last 8 (#1053–#1063). Under map-check v2 a returned probability map is used only if it covers exactly the options shown, every value is finite and in [0, 1], and the values sum to 1 within 1e-6; this sum rule is new (no frozen sum tolerance existed), was chosen on 11 Nov 2026 and applies to this entry only; a failed map still plays the returned choice and stores no probabilities. An offline audit of the first matches under the same rule found no failing map. Option order: we send the options in our seeded order, as for every setup, while Google's docs say the API sorts the option keys alphabetically (UTF-8 byte order; an exact tie goes to the alphabetically first key), so the order the model sees is probably not ours (Google's docs; not verified by us). Its cost is the billed cost of each decision; the entry, with its paid opponents, billed $1.1819 in all.; hosted (API or subscription)
